title: ONE TEAMMATE COLOUR
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid reads like a shooter HUD, where a teammate has one colour. His name over his head was amber, the colour of keys and of your own Waypoint, while his row on the left, his map mark and his Waypoint were blue; his edge arrow was amber and his ping cyan, close to the extraction colour. A teammate is now the one ally blue wherever he is named or marked, and danger red while he is down. Your own ping is amber, like your Waypoint.
now: A teammate is one ally blue wherever he is named or marked, and red while he is down.
